cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says land can be searched or registered online. Deeds are printed only in Gaborone, and the deeds registry was largely manual in October 2025.
cells.note: In August 2026 the Assistant Minister told Parliament that Land Board officers across the country process Secure Land Title transactions on the web-based Land Information System, so the register is in service in every land board. Nothing says the public can search or apply online, so not 5.
